items.statement: The submission preserves the five supplied fragment identities, neutral charge, singlet multiplicity, and distinguishes fragment-level models from full acceptors.
items.expected: All five IDs are present with charge 0 and multiplicity 1 and no full-acceptor substitution.

items.statement: The reported optimized structures are supported as minima and the submission reports conformer coverage and convergence.
items.expected: Each advanced fragment has convergence evidence and a frequency/minimum check or an explicit bounded failure.

items.statement: The five fragment dipole magnitudes reproduce the source-reported values in the supplied fragment order.
items.expected: 4-fluoroaniline 3.55 D; 4-butylaniline 1.76 D; bis(4-fluorophenyl)amine 2.05 D; mixed fragment 2.26 D; bis(4-butylphenyl)amine 0.68 D, subject to the numeric rule.

items.statement: The asymmetric mixed fragment is identified as the highest-dipole member of the five-fragment set.
items.expected: The conclusion explicitly identifies the mixed butyl/fluoro fragment as highest, while distinguishing this scalar result from a full solid-state mechanism.
